subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram slash sessions still resolve to channel=(unknown), causing elevated allowFrom checks to fail on 2026.3.13

question: Which canonical repair should own the remaining bare Telegram slash-session channel identity gap in `sandbox explain` and elevated diagnostics?
rationale: The remaining source-visible bug is narrow, but it sits on the elevated host-command authorization boundary and already has competing open fork candidates.

options.title: Adopt scoped-key normalization
options.body: Normalize non-agent-scoped slash keys into the current agent session-key shape before lookup, then add regression and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Adopt static channel inference
options.body: Teach diagnostics to infer known channel prefixes from bare keys without changing the normalized session key shape.

options.title: Pause for live repro first
options.body: Require a maintainer-run Telegram elevated exec repro before choosing a repair path, leaving this issue as the canonical tracker.

recommendation.title: Adopt scoped-key normalization
recommendation.body: Normalize non-agent-scoped slash keys into the current agent session-key shape before lookup, then add regression and live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is on `sandbox explain`, native command session targeting, and the recent refactors carrying this authorization surface.
